name: Hegai
bio: Hegai, the king's chamberlain, was keeper of the women gathered to the harem when Ahasuerus searched his empire for a new queen. He favored Esther above the other young women, quickly giving her beauty treatments, maidservants, and the best place in the harem, and his guidance helped her win favor with everyone who saw her (Esther 2:3-15).
